blocks.x: Tele Medicine Platform's architecture: the planes, the controls and the evidence export — documented the way your auditors will read it.

The Tele Medicine Platform architecture is three planes and an evidence spine. Modules compose behind one governed API; every decision crossing a plane boundary is logged with the inputs, the policy version and the accountable owner.

Runtime dependencies: SIEM/XDR, SPIFFE/SPIRE, OPA, IdPs/IGA, CNAPP tooling. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for Tele Medicine Platform follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
